unknownwiki-body:
Domain-kan wuxuu tilmaamayaa Miraheze, laakiin ma jiro wiki loo habeeyey inuu u adeego.
Haddii aad gudbisay codsi domain gaar ah, mar kale booqo dhowr daqiiqo gudahood.

wiki-not-found-browse: Wiki-gan kama jiro adeegayaashayada. Waxaad ka dhex baari kartaa wiki-yada ku jira shabakaddeenna [https://meta.miraheze.org/wiki/Special:WikiDiscover|halkan] ama [https://archive.org/search.php?query=miraheze|ka daawan kartaa kaydadka archive.org].
wiki-not-found-contact: Haddii tani ay dhibaato tahay, fadlan [https://meta.miraheze.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Help_center|nala soo xiriir].
